nodes.description: mapping(bytes32=>uint256) public orderFills tracking how much of each signed order has been filled
address payable public owner, protocol fee recipient and admin
address payable public feeAccount, secondary fee recipient
address public baeContract, ERC1155 artwork token contract
uint256 public fee, owner fee in per-mille units (default 40)
uint256 public creatorFee, creator fee in per-mille units (default 50)
mapping(bytes32=>bool) public traded, unused order-traded flag
function changeFee(uint256 _amount) public onlyAdmin, updates the owner fee
function changeCreatorFee(uint256 _amount) public onlyAdmin, updates the creator fee
function invalidateOrder(...) public, verifies EIP-191 signature and marks the order fully filled
function isValidOrder(...) public view, validates signature, balance, fill amount and expiry
function buyArtworkETH(...) public payable, executes an ETH purchase of ERC1155 artwork and distributes fees
receive() external payable, accepts plain ETH transfers
msg.sender, caller-controlled address used for admin checks, buyer identity and refund recipient
block.timestamp, miner-influenced value used for order expiry checks
feeAccount.transfer(amount.mul(10).div(1000)), external ETH send to protocol fee account
owner.transfer(amount.mul(fee).div(1000)), external ETH send to owner-controlled address
payable(IERC1155(baeContract).creators(id)).transfer(...), external call plus ETH send to creator from an untrusted contract
tradeAddresses[1].transfer(amount.mul(1000-fee-creatorFee-10).div(1000)), external ETH send to the maker
msg.sender.transfer(msg.value - amount), external ETH refund to the caller
IERC1155(baeContract).safeTransferFrom(...), external call into an arbitrary token contract with a data payload
ecrecover over the EIP-191 prefixed orderHash, signature-derived identity check
orderFills[orderHash].add(tradeValues[5]) SafeMath addition used to update the fill counter
tradeValues[2].mul(tradeValues[5]) SafeMath multiplication computing the ETH amount
uint256[6] tradeValues parameter of buyArtworkETH: token, prints, price, expires, nonce, amount
address payable[2] tradeAddresses parameter of buyArtworkETH: tokenSell, maker
uint8 v signature recovery id in buyArtworkETH
bytes32[2] rs signature r,s values in buyArtworkETH
uint256 _amount parameter of changeFee, new fee value
uint256 _amount parameter of changeCreatorFee, new creatorFee value
uint256[5] tradeValues parameter of invalidateOrder
address[2] tradeAddresses parameter of invalidateOrder
uint8 v signature recovery id in invalidateOrder
bytes32[2] rs signature values in invalidateOrder
uint256[5] tradeValues parameter of isValidOrder
address[2] tradeAddresses parameter of isValidOrder
uint8 v signature recovery id in isValidOrder
bytes32[2] rs signature values in isValidOrder
bytes32 orderHash computed in buyArtworkETH as keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...))
uint256 amount = tradeValues[2].mul(tradeValues[5]) local in buyArtworkETH
bytes32 orderHash computed locally inside invalidateOrder
bytes32 orderHash computed locally inside isValidOrder

buyArtworkETH performs owner.transfer for the owner fee

maker ETH transfer occurs before the orderFills state update, enabling reentrancy
creator ETH transfer via an untrusted token contract occurs before orderFills is updated
amount local variable feeds the feeAccount.transfer value
amount local variable determines the msg.sender ETH refund

feeAccount state variable receives the protocol fee transfer
owner state variable receives the owner fee transfer
fee state variable scales the amount sent to owner
creatorFee state variable scales the amount sent to the creator
msg.sender is the recipient of the residual ETH refund
